name: @tinplate/sdk
description: Zero-dependency TypeScript & JavaScript SDK for the Tinplate 32-API AI Safety, Security & Format Validation Edge Gateway.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const r=cp.spawnSync('tsc',['--version'],{shell:true,stdio:'ignore'});if(r.status===0){const b=cp.spawnSync('tsc',['-p','tsconfig.json'],{shell:true,stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(b.status??1);}if(!fs.existsSync('dist/index.js')||!fs.existsSync('dist/index.d.ts')){console.error('tsc not found and dist/ missing');process.exit(1);}"
